stem: What is the most likely reason the author organizes the sections “From Marsh to Masterpiece” and “Then and Now” using comparison?

options.label: A
options.text: To emphasize Venice’s transformation and the many challenges it has overcome over time

options.label: B
options.text: To entertain the reader with the dramatic story of Venice’s founding and the people who inhabit the city today

options.label: C
options.text: To inform the reader about historical developments in engineering and urban planning that work effectively with nature

options.label: D
options.text: To discuss the historical significance of the city and place it in a larger context
